fixture_defaults: Unless a case explicitly changes them, all other contract acquisition, frozen bindings, current-root, state, file-layout and resource requirements conform.
The fixture is an isolated private temporary LAB_TEST lab, with required roots provisioned and no sticky fault or unsupported action.
OS descriptor limits are sufficient for the nominal boundary cases; lower-limit refusal is exercised separately.
Each stated variant must be exercised independently; a positive case does not certify unrelated or out-of-scope properties.
